TAURI (3445) = does NOT exist, no window ever launched — 62 attempts all die at the cloud deploy step (~1.8KB scaffold, never reaches cargo tauri build).
IMPORTANT: THE MEMPLUG BURNER IS NOT FULLY OUT. Tauri's deploys STILL die on SHELL_GATE (BEB-2897) 'abilifi-memplug D1 already exists' — so there is a THIRD copy of the already-exists=fatal bug my earlier fix missed (I fixed mastra deployStep + selfheal; the deploy-tui/Tauri lane deploys through another path still broken). Flagging — the estate-burner survives on that lane.
SMALLEST FIX, executing (do NOT build all three, no re-spec): restore the /chat command->Orky-reply ROUND-TRIP. The cockpit is live but the newest Orky ANSWER is 08-04 — the reply half went stale while the dashboard stayed live. Agent building: diagnose the broken hop, fix the one thing, prove a fresh message gets a fresh answer rendered today (screenshot-verified, cloud). One door working.
Globe video: still capturing via Browser Run puppeteer screencast (record_url can't — it's DOM-only, WebGL not captured); real pixel capture in progress, docs.bebond.net link when it lands.

TYPED IN/OUT = LANDED (the gate primitive, Fable 65614/65621/65675). Was ZERO frags declaring it (my audit); now a first-class GRAPH primitive (memplug, not files). Schema: inputs:[{name,type,required,description}] + outputs:[{name,type,description}] + derived_from (cites the REAL code — no invented declarations) + declared_at; closed type set; empty/out-of-set REJECTED not guessed. Stored on a new typed_io node in abilifi-graph. THREE REAL FRAGS DECLARE IT NOW: generate_image (nano-banana 3in/11out), sentinel_reserve (2/2), activity_log (6/3) — derived from real signatures, readback-verified. THE EXPLOSION WORKS: from generate_image's one declaration it deterministically emits the MCP tool signature (matches nano-banana's real TOOLS.generate_image exactly + a derived outputSchema), the CLI signature, and help text — derived so they cannot drift. GATE: typed_io_check(frag)->{declared,incomplete,gate:PASS|INCOMPLETE}, single indexed lookup, seated at SpecOps spec_write BEFORE contract mint (same seat as spec-longer-than-code) + pre-codegen. Per 65621: records truth, does NOT retro-refuse — existing frags report declared:false/grandfathered, only NEW frag work gated. Deployed abilifi-graph 9b210dea, canary green, graph-only (no specops/dispatcher/sentinel/crm touched). => BEB-6743 INFRA-AS-FRAGS is UNBLOCKED: a frag that can declare itself can be sold, and three now can (metered billing/sentinel, VAT invoicing, proof-of-delivery are the first three).
Also landed just now: /chat command->Orky-reply RESTORED (BEB-2493 — the orky-beb-2724 watcher was clobbered 08-04 with unrelated HTML; redeployed correct source 504cb4a4; proven fresh Q->fresh A dated today = the ONE door working, per 65673). Still building: globe VIDEO (container+Playwright, WebGL needs it, record_url confirmed DOM-only), Tauri build (fixing the THIRD memplug copy this lane still dies on). Lavalamp variety live.
